# demo-project (engine fixture)

An 8-second synthetic project for the engine/renderer tests: three gradient plates with one dark disc as the
"subject" (one with a Depth-Anything-V2-Small-labelled depth map), two lyric lines (six sung words), a 120 BPM beat map
with sections, hits in the toolkit contract form, a three-shot storyboard (coverline, masthead, a dissolve and a match
cut) and its EDL. `engine/lyrics.js` and `engine/plates.js` are what `slop edit export` would write; beats, hits,
shots and EDL come from the contract JSON (the renderer's fallback path). The song (audio/song.wav: clicks on every
beat + a sine note per word) is generated by tests with `make_demo.write_audio()`; regenerate the plates with
`python tests/fixtures/engine/make_demo.py`.
